## CP5 — Reminders engine (separate workflow, bot-automated)
Schedule (hourly) → Load Config (minimal) → Kill-Switch Gate → Compute Reminder Window → Find Due → Build Payload → Send STUB → Stamp Reminded. Find Due / Stamp errors → Reminder Error (visible; owner-alert = Phase 5).

**STUB send:** Phase 4 swaps the NoOp for HTTP Request → Zernio send; payload {channel,to,text} is real now (one-node swap).
**Dedupe (two fields):** `reminded` (checkbox) = CONTROL — Find Due selects NOT({reminded}); Stamp sets reminded=true (send-first, stamp-after-success = at-least-once); reschedule sets reminded=false so a moved appointment re-reminds. `reminder_sent` (dateTime) = INFO only (native n8n can't clear a dateTime — null omitted, '' rejected).
**Limits (T1):** Airtable mirror is the source; a GCal-direct cancel could still be reminded; mirror_failed rows get no reminder; two overlapping schedule runs could double-send (accepted TOCTOU, hourly cadence).

nodes.name: Send Reminder (STUB)
nodes.notes: STUB — Phase 4 replaces this with HTTP Request → Zernio send. Payload {channel,to,text} is on the incoming item (reminder_payload). In Phase 4 this node's onError must route to Reminder Error (NOT Stamp) to keep at-least-once.

nodes.name: Reminder Error
nodes.notes: Visible failure branch for Airtable read/write errors in the reminder run (infra class). Owner-alert (Telegram) = Phase 5. A failed Stamp leaves reminder_sent empty → next run retries (at-least-once).
